events.text:
For Willow Plus, “cancel” can mean a few different things. Please choose one:

- Stop renewal: effective 2027-01-12 00:00 UTC. You keep Plus benefits through 2027-01-11, there is no charge on 2027-01-12, no refund, and all 4,820 points stay.
- Pause: effective 2026-10-01 00:00 UTC. Benefits pause from 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31, renewal moves to 2027-04-12, and all 4,820 points stay.
- Cancel now: effective 2026-09-30 09:00 UTC. Benefits end today, you get a $22.51 refund, and 1,200 Plus bonus points are forfeited, leaving 3,620 points.

Which change do you want?
